fixture.description: Two-second generated harmonic vowel-like fixture; three Gaussian resonant envelopes plus a 0.025 baseline; amplitude decreases with sqrt(harmonic number), deterministic harmonic phases, 25 ms attack/release, 0.65 peak.

method.f0: Hann DFT peak near expected fundamental, 0.125 Hz grid and log-magnitude interpolation. Separately measure the strongest harmonic peak and divide by its harmonic index; retain both results because a weak fundamental can have different leakage/sidebands.
method.envelope: Gain-normalized dB residual to the known analytic envelope over harmonic amplitudes; search all net envelope shifts from -2600 to +2600 cents in 5-cent steps. This is an aggregate envelope fit, not a human-vowel/formant tracker.
method.peaks: Local harmonic-magnitude maxima with 3-point log-magnitude interpolation; no result if a peak lacks neighboring harmonics. Sparse harmonics and changed envelope widths limit peak precision.
method.qualityFlags: Observational flags at >100 cents aggregate fit error, >6 dB target envelope RMSE, unresolved resonance, >1 peak, or >0.2 cents weak-fundamental error. They are not perceptual acceptance criteria.

recordedRejectedCandidates.status: Historical measurements of the unguarded candidate; the final application rejects every combination in this file.
recordedRejectedCandidates.differenceFromFinalRenderer: The candidate allowed an effective envelope pre-shift beyond ±1200 cents. These are recorded measurements, not a current renderer execution or a passing quality result.
recordedRejectedCandidates.reproduction: The earlier candidate run used node scripts/pitch-poc/formants.mjs with the same pinned WASM, analytic fixture, and formula, before the combined-shift validation was added. The final script replays the same requests to verify their explicit rejection and retains these historical measurements as evidence for that restriction.

fixture.description: Two-second generated harmonic vowel-like fixture; three Gaussian resonant envelopes plus a 0.025 baseline; amplitude decreases with sqrt(harmonic number), deterministic harmonic phases, 25 ms attack/release, 0.65 peak.

limits: Synthetic measurement only; no listening evaluation or natural-voice validation.
Envelope smoothing is approximate; sparse harmonics at high F0 and large combined shifts can move, smear, or erase individual peaks.
Resampling cannot reconstruct harmonics absent from the original source or above the final Nyquist limit.
Unchanged audio bypasses exactly; edited note boundaries retain the source through short crossfades.
Historical unguarded candidate failures are retained separately and are not results from the final renderer.
